title: Charts from a project's records: review budgets saved, get_charts, get_results without the holes
request: Owner, after a real BNPL credit-risk chat in DCLab Code: build D9, real charts in the chat from DCLab's records (feature recipes, model screen, holdout with its range, calibration), precision/recall at a review budget saved by DCLab, options as clickable question cards. Do not wait for me.
spec: dclab_core/model_evaluation.py (BUDGETS, review_budgets), dclab_rnd/studio/charts.py, dclab_rnd/intern/tools.py (get_charts, _final_measures, one-stage get_results), dclab_rnd/mcp_server.py (keep-alive)
plan: read what the BNPL records hold
a chart builder over the records
the get_charts tool and get_results' final numbers
tests, a scan of every real record, review, harness-eval

decisions.decision: no new holdout read: budgets are exact at the single read (evaluate) and read from the kept gains curve for older projects
decisions.why: rule 2: the holdout is used once; the records already kept the gains curve at 1 % steps

decisions.decision: charts as numbers from deterministic code; the page draws, the model only explains
decisions.why: rule 5: code owns metrics; the model had drawn text bars and called kept numbers missing

decisions.decision: fix get_results rather than only add charts
decisions.why: compact_record kept only ROC-AUC of the final stage, so 'plot accuracy' was refused while accuracy, precision, recall, the threshold table and the curves were in final.json

decisions.decision: a one-stage get_results says which stages ran and that the final ran, with its score, interval and where the rest is
decisions.why: live: Claude read the models stage alone and offered to run a final that had already read the holdout

decisions.decision: uvicorn keep-alive 75 s on the local MCP server
decisions.why: live: the first get_charts call met ECONNRESET with nothing in the server log: an idle socket closed at uvicorn's 5 s and reused by the client

change: dclab_core 0.122.0 (review_budgets); dclab_rnd/studio/charts.py (new); dclab_rnd/intern/tools.py; dclab_rnd/mcp_server.py; tests; HRN-055.

findings.defect: every uplift project's get_results, run_stage('final'), run_all and get_charts raised
findings.cause: from_record did int(holdout_rows), and uplift keeps the holdout's row positions as a list; TypeError is not a mapped tool error
findings.fix: n from a count or the list's length; from_record wrapped in _final_measures and charts
findings.test: test_review_findings_uplift_rows_declared_columns_caught_leaks_and_direction; test_kind_engine_library UpliftInTheEngineTest passes again; 2,738 real projects scanned without an error

findings.scenario: a new project tool changes the specs the models see
findings.cause: harness-eval not rerun after the tool was added

findings.defect: the leakage chart said 'leak suspects to review' on most real tabular projects
findings.scenario: a declared leak column, already kept out
findings.cause: the leakage stage lists declared columns among its candidates (declared_post_outcome_or_contested); they were counted as suspects and shown twice
findings.fix: a candidate already kept out or declared is not a suspect

findings.defect: 'no leak found' claimed where no detector ran
findings.scenario: machine kinds (uplift, streams, survival...) keep detector_canary_passed and apparent_lift as None
findings.cause: the verdict chain fell through to its last branch
findings.fix: 'no detector run: the kind's own checks only', a neutral 'Not measured' badge on the page

findings.defect: forecasting (MASE) and survival (integrated Brier) charts said higher is better
findings.cause: a private lower-is-better list missed them; records do not carry the direction
findings.fix: the list holds every lower-is-better primary metric the 2,738 records use

findings.defect: a caught leak read as an alarm
findings.scenario: 916 of 2,738 projects: the declared columns would lift the score and are kept out
findings.cause: verdict 'the unsafe columns lift the score' with a red Leak badge
findings.fix: 'leak caught and kept out', badge Caught

findings.defect: the intern got cut chart JSON
findings.cause: 4 decimals, 21-point curves, long rules, per-row repeats
findings.fix: 3 decimals, 15 points, rules to 150 characters, positives and source once per table: largest 5,960
findings.test: chart size asserted below RESULT_CHARS; scan of every real project

findings.defect: Claude offered to run the final stage again
findings.scenario: 'what are my options now?' on a built project
findings.cause: get_results(stage='models') told nothing of the project's state
findings.fix: stages_run and final_already_ran (score, interval, where the measures are, that a rerun reads the holdout again)

measurements.result: 129 tests in 9 files (charts, evaluation, registry, intern, mcp, uplift and forecasting engines, twin, harness)

measurements.name: scan
measurements.gate: no error, every chart set within RESULT_CHARS
measurements.result: 2,738 real projects of 13 kinds: no error; largest 5,960 characters

measurements.name: harness-eval
measurements.gate: every case right on every step

measurements.name: live (Sonnet 5.5, scripted test home)
measurements.gate: plots go through get_charts; a choice is a card; no rerun of a built final
measurements.result: get_charts called and explained ($0.18); a review-capacity question answered from the budgets ($0.19); a model choice asked as a card ($0.15); after the fix the final was not offered again ($0.08)

outcome: A built project's charts come from its records in one call, accuracy and review budgets are no longer hidden, and the leakage verdict says what the audit actually found.
lessons: Before saying a number is missing, check what the summary function drops: the record had it.
Run a new reader over every real record on disk, not a fixture: one kind stored a field as a list.
A verdict needs a branch for 'not measured'; falling through to the good answer is a claim.
A one-stage view of a project needs the project's state beside it.
risks: make core-wheel-check not run (daytime: affected tests only).
